story: Audacity: Actions we propose to take on PR 835
text: His reviews of the various scorewriters (Sibelius, Musescore, Dorico) are also fantastic, even if you are not into music. His video Stock Music & Reality TV - How to Misrepresent the World [1] is also really good. [1] [VIDEO]
